dogecoin.text: what if dogecoin was a spaceship that took off from earth and landed on a planet made of memes
in a world where dogecoin is the currency of mars we trade memes for spaceships and the moon is just a giant ledger
if cryptocurrency prices were flavors of ice cream bitcoin would be rocky road ethereum would be mint chip and dogecoin would be bubblegum because its fun but also a little weird
if dogecoin was a spaceship it would be lost in orbit around the moon with a cargo hold full of memes and a crew of shibes trying to find their way back to earth
Bitcoin is going to reach a million dollars and everyone who doesn't invest will be left behind to eat dogecoin flavored ramen noodles
Dogecoin's intergalactic takeover is no joke, it's officially the currency of Pluto, meanwhile Elon's over on Mars probably wondering how he missed the boat on this one
